scientific_role: Independent reconstruction/replication of the published protocol-demand mechanism using a different public data source. This is not a claim of a novel edge and cannot by itself be promoted to production.
source_dependency: EDFF_SOURCE_FULL or EDFF_SOURCE_LIMITED with enough valid days; BLOCKED stops before market outcomes.

fee_signal.smooth_method: simple trailing mean including day t
fee_signal.reference_method: median of raw Flow Intensity over the 90 days ending t-1 (past-only)

alignment.information_available: after UTC day t is complete
alignment.entry_price: ETHUSDT daily OPEN at t+1 UTC
alignment.primary_exit_price: daily OPEN at t+46 UTC, giving a 45-day holding interval from entry

placebo_2023.role: pre-Dencun placebo/control; report only and must not be used to tune the post-Dencun rule

primary_post_dencun_2024.role: primary replication window; all 45-day exits remain inside 2024

primary_test.model: OLS future 45-day log return = alpha + beta * FlowDeviation

frozen_secondary_horizons.alignment: entry at t+1 open, exit at t+1+h open, clipped so exit remains <= year-end
frozen_secondary_horizons.role: sign/shape robustness only; cannot rescue a failed 45-day primary

REPLICATION_SUPPORTS_MECHANISM: both 30d and 60d secondary beta estimates are > 0
REPLICATION_MIXED: but one or more SUPPORTS_MECHANISM requirements fail

placebo_interpretation: A weaker/insignificant 2023 placebo is supportive context only. A strong 2023 result does not automatically fail the mechanism because the primary test is explicitly post-Dencun.
no_rescue: Do not change 30-day smoothing after outcomes.
Do not change 90-day median reference after outcomes.
Do not change 45-day primary horizon after outcomes.
Do not switch same-day/next-day alignment after outcomes.
Do not change sign direction after outcomes.
Do not convert this replication into a trading strategy after seeing results without a fresh prefreeze.
